tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Find Agent Skills in the registry. Use this first to discover skills: pass a free-text query (e.g. "debug a failing test"), a category, or both. Omit query to browse a category or the whole catalog by sort order. Returns up to 20 summaries per page; use page to continue while hasMore is true, then c

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Read one skill in full: the SKILL.md content, metadata, automatic safety summary, extra files and project-scope install commands for every supported agent. Use after search_skills, and always read the content and safety summary before installing. Premium skills return a preview plus a buy link.

tools.name: get_install_command
tools.description: Build the one-line shell command that installs a skill for a specific agent and scope. Use when you need a user-wide install (scope "user") or only the command without the full skill; get_skill already includes project-scope commands. Does not run anything.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List curated collections: bundles of skills that work well together (e.g. a starter pack or a data-science kit). Use to discover collection slugs, optionally filtered by a text query, then call get_collection for the skills inside.

tools.name: get_collection
tools.description: Get one curated collection by slug: its title, description, the names of the skills it contains, and a zip URL that installs all of them at once. Use after list_collections; read individual skills with get_skill.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the skill categories (id and label). Use the id as the category filter of search_skills when you want to browse a whole area such as coding or data.
